abstract: International tax evasion is a major source of discontent for tax authorities. State purchases of bank data on suspected tax evaders from international tax havens constitute one tool to combat such tax evasion. Increasing the risks of detection, such purchases may spur voluntary disclosures for fear of facing charges for tax fraud. Tax authorities in Germany have made repeated use of this tool in recent years, above all in North-Rhine Westphalia, Germany's most populous federal state. Using self-compiled data for North-Rhine Westphalia on the timing and content of data acquisitions and on monthly voluntary disclosures of international tax evasion involving Swiss banks, we study the effects that such acquisitions had on the evolution of voluntary disclosures over time. Our results show that purchases of data on potential tax evaders had a positive and sizeable effect on voluntary disclosures. Various robustness checks and additional explorations corroborate this conclusion.""'
abstract_zh: 国际逃税是税务机关不满的主要来源。国家从国际避税天堂购买涉嫌逃税者的银行数据，是打击此类逃税行为的一种工具。增加被发现的風險，此类购买可能促使纳税人因担心面临税务欺诈指控而自愿披露。近年来，德国税务机关反复使用这一工具，尤其是在德国人口最多的联邦州——北莱茵-威斯特法伦州。利用自行编制的北莱茵-威斯特法伦州数据收购时间与内容以及涉及瑞士银行的国际逃税月度自愿披露数据，我们研究了这些收购对自愿披露随时间演变的影响。结果显示，购买潜在逃税者数据对自愿披露产生了积极且显著的影响。多种稳健性检验和额外探索进一步证实了这一结论。
source_issue: Journal of Comparative Economics, Volume 54, Issue 2
title: International tax evasion, state purchases of confidential bank data and voluntary disclosures
title_zh: 国际逃税、国家购买保密银行数据与自愿披露

abstract: This article examines the influence of economic policy uncertainty (EPU) on price volatility in China’s agricultural futures markets, utilizing monthly data from July 2006 to December 2023 and employing a TVP-VAR-SV model, with a focus on the mediating role of commodity financialization. Empirical results reveal: (1) Domestic EPU exerts a stronger influence on agricultural futures volatility than global EPU. (2) Heightened commodity financialization amplifies price fluctuations and serves as a transmission channel for both domestic and global EPU effects. (3) Major unexpected events significantly exacerbate the short-term volatility shocks from EPU. (4) Heterogeneous responses exist across agricultural subsectors: while domestic EPU induces directional and magnitude-divergent impacts on different commodity categories, the mediating effect of financialization varies substantially in transmission mechanisms. These findings underscore the intricate interplay between policy uncertainty, financialization dynamics, and the stability of China’s agricultural commodity market.

abstract: While existing CSR literature has largely examined firms’ motivations, disclosures, and outcomes, the implementation of CSR remains underexplored. This study addresses this gap by investigating how the nature of the social cause and ownership structure influence firms’ choice of CSR implementation modes – classified as foundation, direct, or collaboration. These factors offer a compelling lens to explain variation in implementation by capturing the intersection of strategic alignment with societal goals (social cause) and governance orientation (ownership). Drawing on data from India’s top 500 listed firms, the findings reveal that both factors significantly influence implementation choices, reflecting strategic considerations related to control, continuity, and reputational positioning. The study makes two key contributions. First, it advances CSR implementation research by demonstrating how the alignment between cause-specific demands and ownership logics explains variation in firms’ implementation strategies. Second, it integrates the Resource-Based View and Institutional Theory to theorize CSR implementation as a strategically motivated yet institutionally bounded process through which firms balance internal capability building with external legitimacy seeking. Together, these insights deepen understanding of how firms operationalize CSR commitments within their strategic and institutional contexts.
title: Strategic drivers for corporate social responsibility implementation modes: insights from large Indian firms

abstract: In the global context, rural women’s employment status serves as a critical barometer not only for their well-being but also for realizing social equality, driving rural revitalization, and facilitating income growth. This study, within the framework of socio-technical systems theory, examines how digital economy growth affects rural women’s non-agricultural employment in China. It leverages China’s phased the ‘Broadband China’ pilot policy (2010–2020) as a quasi-natural experiment, employing a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) design with longitudinal data from the China Family Panel Studies (CFPS). The empirical findings show that digital infrastructure expansion exerts a positive and statistically significant influence on rural women’s transition to non-agricultural employment. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that this effect varies across groups with differing numbers of household labourers, children, and educational levels. Mechanism analysis grounded in socio-technical systems theory identifies two concurrent pathways: enhanced financial inclusion through reduced barriers to digital financial services, and technology-driven labour market restructuring via increased industrial robot adoption. Findings advance understanding of technological diffusion interacting with institutional contexts to reshape gendered employment patterns in developing economies. Study offers insights for policymakers aligning digital strategies with rural development to achieve equity in digital economy participation.

abstract: This paper presents new estimates of Anglo‐Italian labour productivity levels in manufacturing in the late 1930s, derived using the standard single‐deflation approach. The findings confirm a substantial productivity gap between Italy and the United Kingdom at the aggregate level, alongside pronounced intersectoral heterogeneity. Italy appears relatively competitive in textiles and, to a lesser extent, in iron and steel and in chemicals. Preliminary estimates using the more advanced double‐deflation methodology, as well as tentative measures of productivity per hour worked, suggest that single‐deflation figures may represent a lower‐bound estimate. Nevertheless, the productivity gap remains large when benchmarked against other industrialized economies, lending support to a more pessimistic interpretation of the Fascist period in terms of labour productivity performance.
abstract_zh: 本文基于标准单一缩减方法，对20世纪30年代末期英意两国制造业劳动生产率水平进行了新的估算。研究结果证实，在总体层面上，意大利与英国之间存在显著的生产率差距，同时伴随着明显的部门间异质性。意大利在纺织业方面相对具有竞争力，在钢铁和化工行业则竞争力稍弱。采用更先进的双重缩减方法进行的初步估算，以及每小时工作生产率的尝试性测量，均表明单一缩减数据可能构成一个下限估计。尽管如此，与其他工业化经济体相比，生产率差距依然巨大，这支持了对法西斯时期劳动生产率表现更为悲观的解读。
title: Chasing the perfida Albione: Anglo‐Italian productivity gap in the late 1930s
title_zh: 追逐背信弃义的阿尔比恩：20世纪30年代末英意生产率差距
